title: Chevron Announces Leadership Changes
summary: Chevron Corporation has announced the election of Uriel "Ose" Oseguera as its new Treasurer, effective November 1, 2026. He will succeed Navin Mahajan, who is retiring after nearly 30 years with the company. Oseguera currently serves as Vice President, Upstream Business Performance & Finance, and will report to CFO Eimear Bonner.

title: Insulet hires Pfizer alum Joan Campion to lead external comms
summary: Insulet, a medical device company, has appointed Joan Campion, formerly of Pfizer, as its new VP of external communications for corporate affairs. This new role is part of a broader effort by Insulet to enhance its communications function under Chief Corporate Affairs Officer Cristal Downing, who also recently joined the company. Campion will be responsible for strengthening Insulet's reputation, visibility, and stakeholder engagement globally, alongside other new hires in the corporate affairs team.

title: INTU SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein, Gewirtz and Grossman, LLC Announces that Intuit Inc. Shareholders with Losses Have Opportunity to Lead Class Action Lawsuit!
summary: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC has announced a class action lawsuit against Intuit Inc. (NASDAQ:INTU) and its officers. The lawsuit alleges that Intuit made false and misleading statements about its business, operations, and prospects between August 22, 2025, and May 20, 2026, particularly regarding its TurboTax revenue growth. Investors who suffered losses have until September 8, 2026, to request to be appointed as lead plaintiff.

title: Horizon Kinetics buys $352 of Texas Pacific Land Corp common stock
summary: Horizon Kinetics Asset Management LLC, a significant owner and director of Texas Pacific Land Corp (NASDAQ:TPL), recently purchased 1 share of the company's common stock for $352.62. This transaction occurred amidst TPL trading at an elevated P/E ratio and being identified as overvalued by InvestingPro analysis, despite the company's strong balance sheet and expansion into data center, power, and water infrastructure.

title: T‑Mobile’s Friday Night 5G Lights Returns Bigger Than Ever with Over $8 Million in Prizes
summary: T-Mobile has announced the third season of its "Friday Night 5G Lights" program, significantly increasing its investment to over $8.4 million in prizes for small-town high schools. The competition features a new divisional bracket format and the return of the $1 million football field upgrade grand prize, championed by Patrick Mahomes and Rob Gronkowski. This initiative aims to celebrate community pride and provide meaningful resources to high schools across America.

title: Alphabet, Amazon, Meta Platforms, and Microsoft: One of These Stocks Looks Like It Has the Least Upside Over the Next 12 Months, but There's a Catch
summary: Among Alphabet, Amazon, Meta Platforms, and Microsoft, Microsoft appears to have the least upside potential over the next 12 months based on current analyst price targets. However, this outlook is skewed by a recent rapid surge in Microsoft's stock price following strong Q4 fiscal 2026 results. Analysts may revise their targets upwards as the initial rally subsides, suggesting the current projection isn't as negative as it initially seems.

title: Morgan Stanley’s Weaver Warns of Risks in AI-Compute Bottleneck
summary: Morgan Stanley's Michelle Weaver warns that artificial intelligence growth is constrained by a persistent bottleneck in computing supply. She notes that demand for AI computing continues to outstrip available capacity and anticipates that power, political, and labor bottlenecks will limit supply for the next few years, preventing an oversupply situation.

title: Labcorp president & CEO Adam Schechter sells $1.5m in company stock
summary: Adam H. Schechter, President & CEO of Labcorp Holdings Inc., sold 4,669 shares of company stock for approximately $1.5 million. The sale was executed pursuant to a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. This transaction occurred as LH stock traded near its 52-week high, following a 29% year-to-date return, and after the company reported strong second-quarter results exceeding analyst expectations.

title: L3Harris launches new facility in Rhode Island to produce undersea training systems
summary: L3Harris has opened a new 50,000-square-foot maritime production facility at ProvPort in Rhode Island, representing a $6 million investment. This facility will support the integration and testing of undersea training ranges for the US and partner nations, leveraging the local workforce and enhancing Rhode Island's role in undersea warfare technology. The move reinforces L3Harris's commitment to the state and its growing capabilities in defense.

title: Why Is Kraft Heinz (KHC) Taking Philadelphia Cream Cheese Into Drinks?
summary: Kraft Heinz's Philadelphia Cream Cheese brand has partnered with Ziggi's Coffee to launch a limited-time "Philadelphia Everything Bagel Latte," marking the brand's first venture into beverages. This move aligns with Kraft Heinz's strategy to extend trusted brands into new consumption occasions and maintain relevance, supporting its narrative of disciplined brand investment and product innovation. The collaboration aims to test the equity of existing brands in fresh contexts, though it doesn't directly address concerns about weak North America retail volumes or brand impairments.

title: Labor unions throw support behind anti-DTE proposal going to Ann Arbor voters
summary: The Huron Valley Area Labor Federation, representing 40 unions and 22,000 members, has endorsed the Ann Arbor for Public Power ballot initiative, which seeks to create a municipal electric utility. This move comes as the federation argues DTE's for-profit model has failed working families, advocating for greater affordability and accountability through public power. The proposal, which qualified for the November ballot, faces opposition from a DTE-backed group that has challenged its validity and funding.

title: Starbucks (SBUX) Stock Could Be 49% Overvalued After Q2 Beat
summary: Starbucks (SBUX) stock has seen a 27.0% gain year-to-date, but analysis by Simply Wall St suggests it may be significantly overvalued. Both a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model and P/E ratio comparison indicate the stock is trading at a premium, with the DCF model pointing to a 49.2% overvaluation. Despite a strong Q2 earnings beat and raised full-year guidance, the current share price appears to incorporate substantial future growth that may be difficult to sustain.

title: Hormel Stock And 2 Defensive U.S. Consumer Staples Picks For Dividend Investors
summary: Amidst stubborn inflation and economic uncertainties, this article highlights three defensive U.S. consumer staples stocks—Reynolds Consumer Products (REYN), Bunge Global (BG), and Hormel Foods (HRL)—that offer dividends and relative stability. It analyzes each company's financial profile, market position, and potential for income-focused investors looking for capital preservation. The article suggests these stocks as initial samples from a broader screen of 23 other compelling income and stability stories within the consumer staples sector.

title: Spectacular new Morgan Stanley display lights up Times Square: ‘Broadway is a bit brighter’
summary: Morgan Stanley has unveiled a spectacular new 21,000-square-foot digital display at its 1585 Broadway headquarters in Times Square. The installation, which features 31.5 million pixels and frequently showcases "CRYPTO" messages, replaces an older display from 2015. Times Square Alliance president Tom Harris noted that this "significant investment" has made Broadway "a bit brighter."

title: Chevron names Uriel Oseguera as treasurer, effective November
summary: Chevron Corporation has appointed Uriel "Ose" Oseguera as its new Treasurer, effective November 1, 2026. He will succeed Navin Mahajan, who is retiring after nearly 30 years with the company. Oseguera will be responsible for Chevron's treasury organization, reporting to Chief Financial Officer Eimear Bonner.

title: FedEx unveils retro 777F as Memphis airport is renamed for founder Fred Smith
summary: FedEx has introduced a Boeing 777 Freighter with a retro livery, N884FD named "Rosie," which is inspired by the Dassault Falcon 20s that launched the company in 1973. This unveiling coincides with the renaming of Memphis International Airport to Frederick W. Smith International Airport, honoring the company's founder. The article details Smith's early vision for an overnight shipping system, his military service, and the company's challenging beginnings, including a famous instance of him gambling to save the business.

title: Liquidia Corporation Stock 12‑Month Price Target Raised to $86.5, Implies 2% Downside
summary: Analysts have raised the average 12-month price target for Liquidia Corporation (LQDA) stock to $86.5 from $84.88, with individual forecasts ranging from $60 to $130 per share. Based on the August 11 closing price, this new target suggests a potential 2% downside. The consensus rating among 9 analysts remains "Buy," with 7 "Buy" and 2 "Hold" recommendations.

title: Intercorp Financial Services Inc. Stock 12‑Month Price Target Raised to $66.46, Implies 16% Upside
summary: Intercorp Financial Services Inc. (IFS) has seen its average 12-month price target raised to $66.46, up from $64.8, by 6 analysts. This updated target suggests a potential 16% upside from its August 11 closing price. The consensus rating for IFS remains a "Buy," with 5 analysts recommending Buy and 1 recommending Hold.

title: CAVA Group, Inc. Stock 12‑Month Price Target Cut to $89.08, Implies 46% Upside
summary: Analysts have slightly lowered the average 12-month price target for CAVA Group, Inc. stock from $92.77 to $89.08, with individual forecasts ranging from $63 to $110 per share. Despite this, the new target still suggests a 46% potential upside based on the Aug. 11 closing price. The consensus rating across 29 analysts remains a "Buy."

title: Brinker International, Inc. Stock 12‑Month Price Target Raised to $212.18, Implies 4% Downside
summary: Analysts have raised the average 12-month price target for Brinker International, Inc. stock from $207.21 to $212.18, with forecasts ranging from $160 to $280 per share. Based on the August 11 closing price, this updated target suggests a potential 4% downside. The consensus rating from 19 analysts remains "Buy," with 14 Buy, 4 Hold, and 1 Sell recommendations.

title: The Honest Company, Inc. Stock 12‑Month Price Target Raised to $5.2
summary: The average 12-month price target for The Honest Company, Inc. (HNST) stock has been raised from $4.82 to $5.2, according to estimates from six analysts. Forecasts for the stock now range from $5 to $5.7 per share, and the consensus rating among seven covering analysts remains a "Buy," with four recommending Buy, two Hold, and one Sell.

title: Apple settles EEOC’s claims the company denied Jewish worker his Sabbath days off
summary: Apple has agreed to pay $150,000 to settle allegations made by the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) that it failed to accommodate a Jewish worker's religious practices and fired him. The company, however, denies these allegations. As part of a two-year consent decree, Apple will update its religious observance policy and provide Title VII compliance training to relevant staff.

title: EQT outlook raised to positive by S&P on debt reduction
summary: S&P Global Ratings has upgraded EQT Corp.'s outlook from stable to positive, affirming its 'BBB-' issuer credit rating, due to significant debt reduction. The natural gas company has repaid over $8.1 billion in debt since September 2024, lowering its total debt to $5.7 billion by June 2026. This positive outlook is based on expectations that EQT will continue to use free cash flow to reduce debt, aiming for a net debt target of $5 billion by 2027.

title: Insider Selling: Labcorp (NYSE:LH) CEO Sells 4,669 Shares of Stock
summary: Labcorp CEO Adam Schechter sold 4,669 shares of company stock for approximately $1.50 million under a pre-arranged trading plan, reducing his total ownership by 4.35%. This sale occurred while Labcorp shares traded near their 52-week high, following strong quarterly earnings that surpassed analyst expectations. Analysts generally maintain a positive outlook on the stock with a consensus "Moderate Buy" rating and a target price of $330.

title: Amgen Stock And The Price Of A Promise
summary: Amgen recently raised its full-year revenue guidance, typically a positive signal, but its stock has not seen a significant celebratory pop. While the company's current performance is strong with multiple products showing double-digit growth, the market appears to have already factored this in. Investors are now looking for the next major catalyst, particularly from Amgen's drug pipeline, especially its experimental weight-loss treatment MariTide, to justify further stock appreciation.

title: Southern Company (NYSE:SO) Moves With Grid And Rate-Sensitive Sector Themes
summary: Southern Company (NYSE:SO) is trading in line with the broader utility sector, influenced by rising Treasury yields and the anticipation of tomorrow's inflation data. The company is experiencing significant demand growth driven by data centers in the Southeast, particularly Georgia, necessitating substantial investment in grid modernization and nuclear generation capacity. Its diversified energy portfolio and strong regional presence position it to address these evolving market and demand dynamics.

title: REGN Stockholders May Be Entitled to Lead the Class Action Lawsuit Against Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. - Contact Robbins LLP for Information About Becoming the Lead Plaintiff
summary: Robbins LLP is reminding investors who purchased Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ: REGN) securities between August 1, 2025, and May 15, 2026, about a securities class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that Regeneron misled investors regarding its Phase 3 Fianlimab-Libtayo clinical trial for advanced melanoma, specifically concerning flaws in statistical assumptions and lack of clinical differentiation. Investors who suffered losses during this period have until September 14, 2026, to seek appointment as lead plaintiff.

title: Insider Selling: WesBanco (NASDAQ:WSBC) EVP Sells $252,360.00 in Stock
summary: WesBanco (NASDAQ:WSBC) EVP Robert Friend sold 6,000 shares of company stock for $252,360, reducing his stake by over 25%. This sale occurred as WSBC shares neared their 52-week high, following strong quarterly earnings that surpassed analyst expectations. The company also maintains a substantial dividend and active share repurchase program, with analysts holding a "Moderate Buy" consensus.

title: Lululemon leads large-caps as a potential acquisition target with 79.8% fair value upside
summary: Lululemon Athletica is identified as a prime acquisition target among large-cap U.S. stocks due to its significant 79.8% fair value upside, strong financials, and premium brand status despite a recent stock decline. The article highlights its low price-to-earnings ratio and healthy balance sheet as key attractors for potential buyers. Other companies like Adobe, Zoetis, and Intuit are also mentioned as potential targets, though with caveats regarding their market cap or debt levels.

title: Barrow Hanley Global Investors (PNW) discloses 5.4% beneficial stake in Pinnacle West
summary: Barrow Hanley Global Investors has disclosed a 5.4% beneficial stake in Pinnacle West Capital Corp (PNW), as reported in a Schedule 13G SEC filing. This represents ownership of 6,575,662 shares, with Barrow Hanley holding sole voting power over 4,188,224 shares and shared voting power over 2,387,438 shares. The firm also has sole dispositive power over all its beneficially owned shares.

title: Constellium outlook raised to positive by Moody’s on strong results
summary: Moody's Ratings has upgraded Constellium SE's outlook from stable to positive, while affirming its Ba3 Corporate Family Rating, Ba3-PD Probability of Default Rating, and Ba3 backed senior unsecured ratings. This positive revision is attributed to Constellium's robust operating performance in the first half of 2026, which surpassed Moody's expectations, leading to significantly strengthened credit metrics despite flat shipments. The company's Moody’s-adjusted EBITDA increased by 110% to nearly $720 million, and it has begun using free cash flow for debt reduction, aligning with its financial policy targets.

title: Moody’s upgrades Rolls-Royce outlook on strong performance
summary: Moody’s Ratings has upgraded Rolls-Royce Holdings' outlook to positive from stable, affirming its A3 long-term issuer ratings due to strong performance across all business divisions and a conservative financial policy. The company's Civil Aerospace unit has shown resilience, complemented by sustained profit increases in its Defence and Power Systems businesses. Moody's anticipates continued profit growth from commercial and operational improvements, expecting Rolls-Royce to maintain a net cash position and execute significant share buybacks through 2028.

title: Bank of Montreal reveals XRP ETF holdings in $303B portfolio filing.
summary: Bank of Montreal (BMO), Canada's second-largest bank, has disclosed holdings in XRP-related ETFs within its U.S. portfolio, which is valued at over $303 billion as of June 2026. This includes shares in the REX-Osprey XRP ETF and ProShares Ultra XRP ETF, demonstrating how traditional financial institutions are gaining exposure to digital assets through regulated investment vehicles rather than direct ownership. This move signals increasing institutional interest in XRP and the broader crypto market.

title: QXO Stock Drifts Lower As Traders Weigh Profitability Path
summary: QXO Inc. stock is experiencing a downturn as traders assess its path to profitability despite multi-billion dollar revenue. While the company boasts a strong balance sheet with over $3 billion in cash, it continues to post losses, leading to a tug-of-war between rapid growth and persistent negative margins. Traders are closely watching key support levels around $15 to determine if the stock will defend its recent gains or slide back to previous levels.

title: QXO Stock Holds Support As Traders Weigh Path To Profitability
summary: QXO Inc. stock has pulled back by 3.4% amid investor concerns regarding its strategic restructuring plans, yet daily charts show potential higher lows forming, suggesting consolidation. The company demonstrates strong revenue growth, exceeding $1.7 billion quarterly, but continues to report net losses, making its path to profitability a key concern for traders. Despite financial leverage, QXO has decent liquidity, and its current price action presents clear support and resistance levels, making it attractive for momentum and swing traders focused on risk management.

title: Deadline Alert: Pentair plc (PNR) Shareholders Who Lost
summary: Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP has issued a deadline alert for shareholders of Pentair plc (PNR) who suffered losses. The firm is reminding investors of the October 2, 2026 deadline to file a lead plaintiff motion in a securities fraud lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that Pentair failed to disclose significant inventory destocking in the Pool channel, which adversely affected its sales and operating income, leading to a substantial drop in stock price.

title: Charles Schwab stock reaches all-time high at 109.33 USD
summary: Charles Schwab Corp (SCHW) stock hit an all-time high of $109.33, reflecting a 1-year change of 14.23% and a market capitalization of $189 billion. InvestingPro analysis indicates the stock remains undervalued, and the company has consistently paid dividends for 38 years. Recent strong quarterly earnings, exceeding expectations with adjusted EPS of $1.62, have led several analysts to raise their price targets for SCHW, citing positive market conditions and strategic positioning.

title: West Pharmaceutical (WST) CFO converts RSUs, withholds shares for taxes
summary: West Pharmaceutical Services Inc.'s CFO, Robert W. McMahon, recently converted 7,149.205 restricted stock units (RSUs) into common stock. A portion of these shares, totaling 3,109.19, were withheld at a price of $351.37 per share to cover tax liabilities or exercise costs. This transaction, which was not executed under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan, resulted in McMahon retaining the remaining common shares.

title: Is DuPont de Nemours (NYSE:DD) Reinforcing Its Dividend Profile
summary: DuPont de Nemours (NYSE:DD) recently increased its dividend, joining a trend of blue-chip companies raising payouts amidst a cautious market environment. As a specialty materials company, DuPont's focus on high-value applications in electronics, water treatment, and industrial markets supports its steady cash flow and ability to maintain and grow its dividend. This move highlights the company's resilient financial profile, even as the broader market experiences volatility, particularly in the tech sector.

title: Dear Intuit Stock Fans, Mark Your Calendars for August 25
summary: Intuit (INTU) is scheduled to report its fiscal fourth-quarter and full-year 2026 results on August 25. The company has faced Wall Street concerns this year regarding AI's potential impact on traditional software businesses, leading to a 53% drop in INTU stock over the past 52 weeks.

summary: Goldman Sachs has maintained a 'Neutral' rating on Leidos Holdings (LDOS) but lowered its price target from $152.00 to $132.00. title: Is Emerson Electric (NYSE:EMR) Cementing Its Dividend Standing
summary: Emerson Electric (NYSE:EMR) recently raised its dividend, joining a trend of industrial payout increases, which has drawn attention as markets remain cautious. The company focuses on automation technology and industrial software, providing critical systems for various sectors. This strategic focus, combined with its blend of hardware and software, positions Emerson Electric as a steady performer, particularly appealing during uncertain market conditions.

title: Nucor (NYSE:NUE) in Focus as Steel Names Draw Attention Before Inflation Data
summary: Nucor (NYSE:NUE) is drawing attention as a prominent steel producer ahead of upcoming inflation data, with equity benchmarks near record highs. Despite thin summer trading volumes and rising Treasury yields, metals have held firm, keeping steel companies like Nucor in focus. The company, known for its diversified, scrap-based electric arc furnace steelmaking, serves various industrial sectors and its performance is closely watched as an indicator for the broader North American steel industry.

title: Is Nordson (NASDAQ:NDSN) Drawing Watch as AI Assembly Demand Meets a Cautious Session?
summary: Nordson (NASDAQ:NDSN), a mid-cap company specializing in precision dispensing and test equipment, is attracting attention as demand for AI assembly technologies grows. The article highlights Nordson's role in electronics and semiconductor manufacturing, providing tools for precise material application and quality verification. Despite a cautious market session ahead of inflation data, Nordson's diversified end-market model across industrial, medical, and electronics sectors helps it navigate cyclical demand and maintain stability.

title: People Inc. CFO Tim Quinn discusses his backgro...
summary: People Inc. CFO Tim Quinn participated in a fireside chat at the Oppenheimer 29th Annual Technology, Internet & Communications Conference. He shared his extensive background, including 12 years with IAC and roles at American Express, emphasizing his close collaboration with leadership and oversight of business operations. This information aims to reassure investors about the company's financial leadership and strategic direction.

title: Tesla files plans for proposed $10.1B Texas solar manufacturing plant
summary: Tesla has filed plans to build a massive $10.1 billion solar cell manufacturing plant in Fort Bend County, Texas, which would create over 9,700 permanent jobs. The project, dubbed "Project Crystal Sun," aims to make Texas a hub for domestic solar cell manufacturing. Tesla plans to begin construction this year and complete it by 2028, with operations starting in 2029, and CEO Elon Musk has previously expressed a goal of 100 gigawatts of domestic solar production.
